# Ubik

> Ubik is an AI-native platform for cross-border trade. It reads email, WhatsApp, ERP and documents, flags supplier, shipment and order exceptions, and drafts the next action for the team to approve. Specialist agents share one trade memory, and nothing is written back without human approval.

Last updated: October 2026.

Ubik is a product of Solarpunk Technology, at theubik.com. It is not the Philip K. Dick novel of the same name, and not the unrelated cube, band, card and hardware products that share the word.

## What it does

Trade context arrives as email, WhatsApp threads, spreadsheets, PDFs, meetings and ERP records, and the decision that matters usually depends on several of them disagreeing. Ubik reads those sources, keeps what it learns as searchable memory, and routes the decision to an operator with its evidence attached before anything is written back.

- RFQ-to-quote, PO ingestion and ERP handoff, VMI, margin protection, traceability
- Memory that compounds across inbox, meetings, projects and trade artifacts, and stays reviewable
- Live market intelligence and import/export project tracking

## Workflows

Each workflow has a trigger, the evidence behind it, a reviewed action and a recorded outcome. Coverage for a customer's systems is confirmed during scoping.

- Supplier updates (/workflows/supplier-followups): sends each supplier their open POs as a weekly sheet, chases replies, and reads them back as ETD, ETA, container and B/L changes.
- Document verification (/workflows/shipment-documents): files supplier documents to their PO, checks invoice, packing list, bill of lading and certificates against each other and the order, and drafts the email that fixes what disagrees.
- Production planning (/workflows/production-planning): tracks each load in the monthly plan against daily production, computes raw material need, flags loads at risk and sends a weekly plant report.
- Packaging tracker (/workflows/packaging-quality): turns artwork, dieline, label and carton emails into tasks with an owner and a deadline, and follows them across customer, printer and vendor until closed on evidence.

## Who it is for

Frozen food importers, exporters, processors and distributors whose working context lives in inboxes and WhatsApp threads rather than in the ERP. The people who feel this first are the ones retyping the same PO into three systems.

## Products

- Teammate (as of October 2026): $1,000 per month for one production workflow on the full Workspace (including the mobile app for the floor), connectors for ERP, CRM and 100+ more apps, no user or token limit. Priced per workflow, not per person.
- Enterprise: custom. Platform plus workflows, priced each, custom decision logic on the customer's own context graph, policy engine and audit trail, and a trade expert and a product engineer on the account
- ubik Meetings: desktop app for Mac (Apple silicon and Intel) and Windows 10 or 11. It records, transcribes and summarizes from your own machine, so no extra bot appears in the guest list.
- Ubik mobile, listed as "Ubik" on Google Play and the App Store: invite-only app for floor staff to photograph paper production records so office teams can review them
- Runs 10+ models including Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Grok

## Security and data handling

Ubik minimizes what reaches external models. Models plan, reason and draft actions; they do not ingest bulk raw data. Sensitive data stays in Ubik's context layer. Audit trail on every change. SOC 2 in progress. Customer data is not used to train third-party models.

## Trade Notes

Trade Notes publishes operating research for perishable-trade teams. Treat published notes as research, not as customer proof.

### The Invisible Drift

Path: /blog/ai-monitor-layer-seafood-trade

Why seafood teams need a monitor layer before LLM output becomes workflow state. Built on a 735-row exhibitor country-attribution task and a 662-row matched A/B comparison, it covers evidence capture, disagreement detection, confidence routing, green/amber/red review queues and human escalation.

Key terms: seafood AI monitoring, LLM disagreement, evidence routing, AI governance in workflows, country attribution, supplier intelligence, model evaluation, Arena leaderboard, perishable trade AI.

### The 60-bps Bleed

Path: /blog/the-60-bps-bleed-shrimp-margin-loss

How a clean-looking shrimp RFQ-to-PO cycle leaks 60 basis points: quote latency, counterparty scoring gaps, FX timing, freight drift, demurrage and detention, temperature deviation, count-size slippage, deglazed-weight economics, forwarder spread, working-capital carry and unclaimed remission.

Key terms: shrimp margin leakage, seafood RFQ workflow, deglazed weight, demurrage detention, AD CVD reserve, seafood trade finance, free-time burn-down, perishable trade AI.

### Origin Roulette 2026

Path: /blog/origin-roulette-2026-shrimp-sourcing

A shrimp buyer strategy note for Q3 2026 and Q1 2027 forward books, comparing Ecuador, India, Vietnam, Indonesia, Thailand, China, Saudi Arabia and Bangladesh on landed-duty stack exposure, AD/CVD risk, EU wild-caught CATCH and Annex IV scope, FDA import certification, value-added processing, halal positioning and origin diversification.

Key terms: shrimp sourcing strategy, warm-water shrimp tariffs, seafood buyer strategy, Ecuador shrimp exports, India shrimp EU FTA, Vietnam shrimp re-export, Indonesia shrimp FDA certification, Saudi shrimp halal, perishable trade AI.
